title: Newspapers, class bias and the French Quarter
summary: Newspapers of the era were circumspect and class-conscious; the studio's world was beneath them and uptown people saw the Quarter as a den of iniquity.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
